name: 牙齿发育、萌出、缺失与阻生状态判断

scoring.aggregation: For each evaluated FDI, award 1 when the predicted status exactly matches the reference status, otherwise 0. The case score is the mean FDI accuracy, including missing and extra FDIs in the denominator.

constraints.counterfactual: When reference_answer contains counterfactual=true and target_teeth is empty, the prompt builder supplies two stable pseudo-random valid FDI values as target teeth; the expected output remains {"teeth": []}.
constraints.ordering: Output teeth in the given target FDI order. Duplicate FDI entries are normalized to one entry.
